mostWorthwhile.text: Sealing the habitat was the most worthwhile action: the backing plate gave a tangible explanation of how the leak stopped, and the repair addressed an immediate danger.

leastWorthwhile.text: Turning the braces into stock was less engaging; its list of potential future uses felt instructional rather than part of the immediate situation.

surprise.text: The shipping braces became general-purpose steel stock, rather than an immediately assembled support.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although applying raw stock directly to the landing support skips over some construction details.

continue.text: I would continue: the grounded repair details and resource reuse make me curious how the expedition develops, even if the choices so far have been straightforward.
